# Level 3 · Classic ML, No Excuses

Before anything with "transformer" in the name, a straight line and a sigmoid should be able to embarrass a bad idea. You fit a line two ways, train a classifier, and write the metrics that tell the truth when accuracy lies. These three drills are the baseline every fancy model has to beat, and the scoreboard it gets judged on.
